With intact contacts, preload vertices from 250 to 400 N and an introduced effective contact stiffness of 10 MN/m, the executed screen gives:

Minimum retained contact compression: approximately 138 N.
Maximum stud tension: approximately 417 N.
Maximum normal-path rotation: approximately 0.025°.
Maximum face-edge movement from that path: approximately 0.0153 mm.

These results do not supply the actual carrier stiffness. A missing contact with its stud still preloaded also behaves differently from deleting the entire station. That distinction matters for fault detection.
